provenance of the frozen v1.2 panel
provenance of the v1.2.1 NER panel used for the comparator cross-check

object.definition: STOCK(c,L,t) = 100 * SUM_{k=0..d-1} A(c,L,t-k) * survival(c,L,t)^(k/d) / SUM_{k=0..d-1} C(c,L,t-k)

symbols.d: declared level duration (DVEC = 6/3/3/4); primary d = 6 for the construct test
symbols.survival: the level-year's declared through-level survival rate

object.class: ratio of two stocks (reconstructed pupil stock / reconstructed official-age band)
declared_choices: constant-hazard holding weights between the fixed endpoints w_0 = 1 and w_d = survival
denominator is the sum of the d entry cohorts (not band_population, which imposes stationarity)
object.repeaters: not represented (the frozen generator has no grade structure and no repeater state); a repeater is representable only as an over-age admission, which is excluded. Declared downward bias; not corrected, not imputed.
object.over_age: excluded from the numerator everywhere (official-age NER); admitted_overage never read
object.left_edge: no stock value before a complete d-year window (primary: 1975); no truncated window, no imputation

test_types.why: highest-2020-GDPpc synthetic type (gdppc 2020 = 48270.81143, rank 1 of 30); the generator's SYN_HKG_LIKE host

construct_test.band_condition: |STOCK - FLOW| <= 2.0 pp in every year with 85.0 <= FLOW <= 95.0 and a complete window
construct_test.crossing_condition: first-sustained (5 consecutive years >= T) crossing years differ by <= 1 y at T = 90 and T = 95
construct_test.terminal: BLOCKED-* is terminal and is not re-specified
construct_test.expected_direction: stock crossings later than flow crossings; a TRANSFER-FAILS on this object is expected and confirmatory (N3)

pre_registered_expectation.sign: systematically negative (stock below flow) in band years
pre_registered_expectation.mechanism: dominated by the holding-weight (attrition) term, with a smaller backward-window/ramp term
pre_registered_expectation.magnitude: NOT predicted, NOT computed at any band year in this design
pre_registered_expectation.consequence: a BLOCKED-MEASURE outcome on the construct test is a live possibility accepted in advance; it is terminal and the object is not re-specified

forbidden_output_strings: HOLDS (bare; TRANSFER-HOLDS is part of the allowed DIAGNOSTIC-TRANSFER vocabulary)
banner: SCALING: FAIL (standing, A12/B02) — DIAGNOSTIC-TRANSFER ONLY — NOT EVIDENCE
labels: DERIVED for arithmetic on the frozen panel
OBSERVED-REFERENCE-ONLY for the HKG series cited in N5 (never read by the object)
No causal, direction, portability, capacity-timing, or phase-verdict claim
notes: No stock value, band year, difference, crossing, or verdict has been computed. results/ does not exist.
The construct test is not executed here and is not authorised here (D120: execution is a further controller action after the freeze and the section 2 hash verification).
No observed series, and in particular no HKG series or target-year value, is read by the object or by the construct test (PRE_DECLARATIONS.md section 3.6; guard G6).
